name: Atari 2600 (VCS)
significance: Turned video games into a multi-billion dollar cultural phenomenon and popularized swappable ROM game cartridges before market saturation led to the 1983 crash.

editorialContent.overview: The machine that popularized microprocessor-based hardware and swappable ROM cartridges in millions of living rooms.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Turned video games into a multi-billion dollar cultural phenomenon and popularized swappable ROM game cartridges before market saturation led to the 1983 crash.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: CX40 single-button digital joystick, paddle controllers
